evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-9:49ef13907bd8:span:49ef13907bd8:20-20
anchor_quotes: The entire group meets back up again and heads to the Cultural Ceremony at the Temple of Aspitome.
The long history of the country and city are depicted here and in the center of the temple is the High Priest.
the High Priest conjures a complex illusion.
This was the Dawn of the Empire.

beats.title: Crystal Magic Sharing
beats.summary: At the ceremony, participants touch a crystal to share magic; Stafl, Ephanna, Karsemine, and Caelynn receive visions, while Baergrom experiences a dwarf-like drumbeat and a raven vision.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-9:49ef13907bd8:span:49ef13907bd8:22-22
anchor_quotes: Just like every year before, everyone can come forward to the crystal and share their magic to help expand the known world.
Stafl is first to approach and touch the crystal. The crystal flashes orange before going dark again.
Ephanna approaches and the crystal flashes purple and a feeling like a reveal of a card trick.
Karsemine sees the crystal flash silver-blue with a feeling of discomfort. She can feel the crystal feeding on her past rage.
Caelynn sees a gray-purple flash of light and then a distant roll of thunder along with a gathering storm and a faceless form of her father.
Baergrom is the last to go, Bonogo does not participate.
At first nothing happens, possibly because of his lack of magic, but then he begins to feel a strong drumbeat - like dwarves working under the mountain.
He sees a vision of the people and dwarves that were lost from his village, then a silver raven takes flight from the old well and leads him down a path.
